title: Reactor Stability Protocol
description: Build a complete reactor monitoring system using all WHILE loop concepts learned.

story.setup:
MENTOR-9: "The reactor is unstable. We need a complete monitoring protocol:

1. Check reactor temperature every cycle
2. If temperature exceeds 150, activate cooling
3. While cooling is active, reduce temp by 10 per cycle
4. Once temp is below 100, deactivate cooling
5. Repeat until reactor runs stable for 3 consecutive cycles
6. Maximum 20 cycles allowed before emergency shutdown

This tests everything you've learned about WHILE loops."
story.context: Real-world automation often involves complex monitoring with multiple conditions, nested logic, and safety limits. This challenge combines counters, boolean flags, nested loops, and BREAK statements.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Outstanding! You built a complete monitoring system. The reactor stabilized safely, and you handled all edge cases. You've mastered WHILE loops—this is production-quality diagnostic code."

hints: Use AND in WHILE conditions: ${a} < 3 AND ${b} < 20
Track both stable cycles and total cycles
Temperature increases at end of each main cycle (fluctuation)
All loops and IFs need proper END statements
solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Reactor Stability Protocol
    ${temperature}=    Set Variable    120
    ${stable_cycles}=    Set Variable    0
    ${total_cycles}=    Set Variable    0
    ${cooling_active}=    Set Variable    False
    WHILE    ${stable_cycles} < 3 AND ${total_cycles} < 20
        ${total_cycles}=    Set Variable    ${total_cycles + 1}
        Log    Cycle ${total_cycles}: Temp ${temperature}°C
        IF    ${temperature} > 150
            ${cooling_active}=    Set Variable    True
            Log    ${SPACE}${SPACE}Cooling activated!
        END
        IF    '${cooling_active}' == 'True'
            WHILE    '${cooling_active}' == 'True' AND ${temperature} > 100
                ${temperature}=    Set Variable    ${temperature - 10}
                Log    ${SPACE}${SPACE}Cooling: Temp now ${temperature}°C
                IF    ${temperature} <= 100
                    ${cooling_active}=    Set Variable    False
                END
            END
        END
        IF    ${temperature} < 150
            ${stable_cycles}=    Set Variable    ${stable_cycles + 1}
            Log    ${SPACE}${SPACE}Stable cycle ${stable_cycles}/3
        ELSE
            ${stable_cycles}=    Set Variable    0
        END
        ${temperature}=    Set Variable    ${temperature + 15}
    END
    IF    ${stable_cycles} == 3
        Log    SUCCESS: Reactor stable!
    ELSE
        Log    WARNING: Emergency shutdown required
    END

theory.title: Challenge 3.1: Reactor Stability Protocol
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "This is it, PROTO-7. A real reactor monitoring system. Multiple conditions, nested logic, safety limits—everything you've learned comes together here."

Complex WHILE Loop Systems

Production automation often requires:

  • Multiple counters: Track different aspects simultaneously
  • Boolean flags: Control sub-systems (cooling on/off)
  • Nested loops: Handle sub-processes (cooling cycle)
  • Compound conditions: Multiple exit criteria (stable OR max cycles)
  • State reset logic: Counter resets when conditions change

⚠️ Challenge Tips

  • Initialize ALL variables before main loop
  • Track BOTH success condition (stable_cycles) AND safety limit (total_cycles)
  • Nested WHILE for cooling—don't confuse with main loop
  • Reset stable_cycles if temperature spikes again
  • Add temperature fluctuation at END of each cycle
  • Check final state after loop exits
